name: @personal-agent/effects
description: Durable transactional side-effect queue algorithm for Scheme B: coalescing rows, ordered kinds, bounded backoff, the Later sentinel, and unknown-native-send parking. The queue algorithm extracted from the upstream dsh-superagent prototype (MIT, DeepSeek Harness Team) with the WP-02 unknown-send classification added; persistence is implemented by @personal-agent/storage.
